item.title: About
item.description:
Burak Can Kaya

M.A. candidate in Interdisciplinary Studies of Middle East at Freie Universität Berlin with a strong foundation in humanitarian action.

Experienced in supporting international humanitarian organizations with a focus on field operations, third-party monitoring, and emergency response in complex and high-need contexts.
